thread:
Jamie: Kicking off readiness QC for aurora3 (new region). Goal: final bring-up checklist + handoff to ops. Quick sync call at 14:30 if needed.
Priya: Thanks — posting the validation checklist i'm running through. tagging @Ben @Sara for ops handoff items.
Ben: 👍 share the smoke commands here and i'll run networking checks after your pass.
Jamie: High level checklist (short):
- Node provisioning: drivers, kubelet, mounts
- GPU sanity: nvidia-smi, memory smoke, sample infer
- Networking: MTU, egress path, NAT gateway, DNS propagation
- Storage: PV mount, restore test, latency sample
- Control plane: API responsiveness, autoscaler test
- SLO gates: p95 token latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%, OOM < 0.1%
- Cost sanity: on-demand burst vs reserved plan delta estimate

Priya: Concrete smoke commands i'm running (pasteable):
```bash
# node & driver
ssh core@aurora3-node-01 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
# kube sanity
kubectl --context=aurora3 get nodes -o wide
kubectl --context=aurora3 -n inference get pods -o wide
# small inference smoke
kubectl --context=aurora3 -n inference run smokeserver --image=redwood/smoke:latest --restart=Never -- sleep 300
kubectl --context=aurora3 -n inference exec -it $(kubectl get po -n inference -l job=smokeserver -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}") -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -sS localhost:8080/health || echo FAIL'
```
Ben: Running MTU + egress checks now. Quick note: watch for mismatched MTU across our overlay; last time a colo had 1400 vs 1500 mismatch and the KV cache panicked.
Sara: I'll validate autoscaler triggers and run a canary spike: 50 concurrent small requests to the model route to ensure scaling and KV warmup. Also will check fallback policy to smaller model under pressure.
infra-ci-bot: CI job aurora3-smoke-tests #487 queued
Jamie: Example smoke output from a recent node (for reference):
```text
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv
name, memory.total
A100-SXM, 40960 MiB
```
Priya: On SLO gating: propose automated gating in console so we block promoting cluster to prod until metric windows are green for 15m. Metrics: p95_end-to-end_latency, grpc_error_rate, node_oom_count. Any objections?
Ben: Agree. Also add kernel OOM logs grep and docker OOM events to the gate. I'll add those alerts to the readiness dashboard.
Sara: For handoff, ops needs: runbook link, service account with readonly access, escalation POC, and the cost-sensitivity flag (burst vs reserve). I'm adding a small cost-estimate table to the runbook.
Jamie: Runbook link (draft): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurora3-bringup (will push a proper page after edits).
Priya: One gotcha we found in staging: DNS TTL propagation delays caused control-plane probes to intermittently fail for ~2mins. Recommend increasing probe retries for initial window.
Ben: noted. I'll set temporary probe retries=5 and retry_interval=10s for the initial 20m after provisioning.
Sara: Ops takeover steps: 1) confirm green gate -> 2) run full traffic ingress test -> 3) flip routing weight 10% -> monitor -> escalate if p95 > 200ms.
Jamie: If everyone's ok, i'll run the final smoke in 5 and then drop the handoff checklist here for signoff.
Priya: Go for it.
infra-ci-bot: aurora3-smoke-tests #487 started: running node, gpu, network checks
Ben: Network smoke passed (MTU consistent, BGP adj up, NAT egress healthy).
Sara: Autoscaler reacted as expected during the canary spike. KV cache warmup added ~40ms to cold starts.
Priya: Smoke run results: all checks green except a transient DNS propagation failure at 14:08 (2m). Retrying probes per Ben's change fixed it.
Jamie: Signing off to handoff: turning over to ops after the 15m gate window. Sara, Ben, confirm when you've accepted.
Ben: Accepted.
Sara: Accepted. Dropping the handoff checklist into ops channel and assigning oncall. :white_check_mark:
